verification_program:
"""Copy actual reviewers' choices; only validate and sum, never estimate minutes."""

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from scripts.export_course import DOCUMENTS, home_introduction
from scripts.reading_time import METHOD, build_inventory, format_range, load_estimates, total_range

root = Path.cwd()
index = json.loads((root / "course/lesson-index.json").read_text())
inventory = build_inventory(root, index, DOCUMENTS, home_introduction(index, True))
expected = {page["page_id"]: page for page in inventory["pages"]}
frozen = json.loads((root / "outputs/reading-time/inventory.json").read_text())
assert len(expected) == len(frozen["pages"]) == 282
for page in frozen["pages"]:
    assert page["source_sha256"] == expected[page["page_id"]]["source_sha256"]
    assert page["figures_sha256"] == expected[page["page_id"]]["figures_sha256"]
journal_path = root / "outputs/integration-runs/reading-time-dispatches.json"
journal = json.loads(journal_path.read_text())
records = {}
reviews = []
for dispatch in journal["dispatches"]:
    group = dispatch["group"]
    path = root / f"docs/reading-time-reviews/integration-{group}.json"
    report = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert dispatch["fork_turns"] == "none" and dispatch["actual_dispatch"] is True
    assert report.get("pending_issues", []) == []
    choices = load_estimates(path, inventory)
    shard = json.loads((root / dispatch["shard_at_dispatch"]).read_text())
    assert set(choices) == {page["page_id"] for page in shard["pages"]}
    assert all(row["reviewer_task"] == dispatch["reviewer_task"] for row in choices.values())
    assert not set(records) & set(choices)
    records.update(choices)
    reviews.append(
        {
            "group": group,
            "path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "reviewer_task": dispatch["reviewer_task"],
            "pages": len(choices),
        }
    )
assert set(records) == set(expected)
for review in reviews:
    completion = next(row for row in journal["completion_checks"] if row["group"] == review["group"])
    assert completion["actual_owner_completion_message_received"] is True
    assert completion["actual_root_source_and_estimate_validation_exit_code"] == 0
    assert completion["report_sha256"] == review["sha256"]

fields = ("page_id", "minutes_min", "minutes_max", "reviewer_task", "reason", "source_sha256", "figures_sha256")
metadata = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "estimate_kind": "ai_estimate",
    "pages": [{key: records[page["page_id"]][key] for key in fields} for page in inventory["pages"]],
}
metadata_path = root / "course/reading-times.json"
assert not metadata_path.exists(), "Preserve any existing actual estimate metadata before a new merge"
metadata_path.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
routes = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "routes": [
        {
            "id": "foundations",
            "label": "入門閱讀：第1–4章、暖身與閱讀指南",
            "page_ids": [
                "course",
                "first-steps",
                *[
                    page["page_id"]
                    for page in inventory["pages"]
                    if page["source"] in {f"course/chapters/{chapter:02d}.md" for chapter in range(1, 5)}
                ],
            ],
        },
        {
            "id": "posttraining",
            "label": "分階段訓練與偏好：7.11、7.17–18、第13章",
            "page_ids": [
                "7.11",
                "7.17",
                "7.18",
                *[page["page_id"] for page in inventory["pages"] if page["source"] == "course/chapters/13.md"],
            ],
        },
        {
            "id": "capstone",
            "label": "整合成品：第19章",
            "page_ids": [page["page_id"] for page in inventory["pages"] if page["source"] == "course/chapters/19.md"],
        },
    ],
}
routes_path = root / "course/reading-time-routes.json"
routes_path.write_text(json.dumps(routes, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
totals = [
    {
        "id": group["id"],
        "label": group["label"],
        "page_count": len(set(group["page_ids"])),
        "minutes_min": total_range(group["page_ids"], records)[0],
        "minutes_max": total_range(group["page_ids"], records)[1],
        "display": format_range(total_range(group["page_ids"], records), total=True),
    }
    for group in [*inventory["groups"], *routes["routes"]]
]
receipt = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "merged_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "scope": "Six actual fresh reviewers personally read the frozen pages, visible CPU outputs and diagrams, then selected each page's interval. The root copied their seven estimate fields unchanged, checked current source/figure hashes and disjoint complete coverage, and summed each listed page once. This program creates no estimates and is not human timing or learning-outcome testing.",
    "method": METHOD,
    "actual_dispatch_and_owner_completion_journal": journal,
    "source_reviews": reviews,
    "authored_pages": 282,
    "metadata_sha256": hashlib.sha256(metadata_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "routes_sha256": hashlib.sha256(routes_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "totals": totals,
    "portable_input_bundle": "docs/reading-time-reviews/inputs-18249322174e/manifest.json",
    "verification_program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
(root / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-reading-time.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
)
print(json.dumps({"authored_pages": 282, "reviews": len(reviews), "totals": totals}, ensure_ascii=False))
